steps.title: Fields Module

audioNote.markdown: From the left-hand menu, select Library and click on the Fields module to manage and create custom fields for your event.

audioNote.markdown: Before creating a field, ensure you have selected the appropriate field type at the top of your page and then select the Add Field button.

steps.title: Add Field

audioNote.markdown: Start by giving your field a name, such as ‘Preferred Language’ or ‘Dietary Restrictions.’

steps.description: Start by giving your field a name, such as ‘Preferred Language’ or ‘Dietary Restrictions.’

audioNote.markdown: Then, choose the appropriate field type from the dropdown menu. Field types include options like text, dropdown, checkbox, and more, depending on how you want users to provide the information.

audioNote.markdown: You can add a description to clarify the purpose of this field for your internal team.

audioNote.markdown: Finally, select the Field Level—choose Event to make the field available only within the current event, or Global to use it across all events in your organization.

audioNote.markdown: Once you’ve completed all the details, click Save to add your new field. The custom field will now appear in the list of fields under the selected category and is ready to use within forms or managing your contacts, evaluation plans, or sessions internally.
